CatalogConfig.title: CatalogConfig
CatalogConfig.description: Global synchronized product catalog and MXN/USD exchange rate configuration across all devices.

products.description: List of digital products and services with MXN and USD prices, availability, and highlights.

exchangeRate.description: Current MXN to USD exchange rate.

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of the last update.

updatedBy.description: Session identifier of the administrator device that saved the update.

authCode.description: Verification code for administrator write authorization.

ScheduleConfig.title: ScheduleConfig
ScheduleConfig.description: Global synchronized appointment schedule, enabled days, and wait time configuration across all devices.

maxWaitMinutes.description: Maximum priority wait time in minutes.

availableDays.description: Days of the week with enabled status.

timeSlots.description: List of formatted time slot strings.

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of the last schedule update.

updatedBy.description: Session identifier of the administrator device that saved the schedule.

authCode.description: Verification code for administrator write authorization.

AdminLockConfig.title: AdminLockConfig
AdminLockConfig.description: Single active administrator lock state across devices.

sessionId.description: Active administrator session ID or empty string when unlocked.

token.description: Active administrator session token or empty string when unlocked.

lastSeen.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of last admin heartbeat.

locked.description: Whether an administrator session is currently active.

authCode.description: Verification code for administrator lock transitions.

ClientPresence.title: ClientPresence
ClientPresence.description: Active connected user session heartbeat for live online user counter.

lastSeen.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of last client heartbeat.
